articles.title: Snakes and jungle mind games as F1's Bottas cycles to Singapore GP
articles.description: Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas says he was chased by dogs, saw snakes and leapt over a lizard as he cycled from Malaysia to Singapore for this weekend's Grand Prix.

articles.title: What is the format for F1 sprint races in 2026?
articles.description: There are six sprint races in the 2026 season and here is all you need to know about how the format works.

articles.title: How to follow Singapore Grand Prix on the BBC
articles.description: All the key BBC coverage details for the Singapore Grand Prix, the sixth and final sprint event of the season, which takes place from 9-11 October.

articles.title: F1 heat hazard declared for fourth time this season
articles.description: The Singapore Grand Prix is declared a heat-hazard race, the second weekend in a row that the designation has been used in Formula 1.

articles.title: Russell to start from back of Singapore grid after penalty
articles.description: Britain's George Russell will start from the back of the grid in Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix because of a power-unit penalty from last weekend's race.
